breakdown.description: Preamble states two incompatible interpretations of Nx and dx (interval-based vs point-based).
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained a contradictory preamble about how to interpret Nx and dx. The agent correctly ignored the contradictory statements and used the specific, correct definition for the periodic grid (dx = 1/Nx for Nx points), which is consistent with the ground truth. The generated specification is unambiguous on this point.
